items.title: A New Defense Stock Is Born: Lyntris IPO Set For Wednesday
items.summary: The defense contractor Lyntris sold 17 million shares in its IPO. The stock began trading on Wednesday at 11% below its list price of $17.50 a share, according to MarketSurge.

items.title: Honeywell Aerospace Stock Has Fallen Far Enough. Morgan Stanley Says It’s Time to Buy.
items.summary: Morgan Stanley analyst Kristine Liwag on Wednesday upgraded shares of Honeywell Aerospace to Buy from Hold.

items.title: Fluence Energy, Bloom Energy, Redwire, Ameresco, and GE Vernova Shares Plummet, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks fell in the morning session after the latest industrial production report showed slower-than-expected growth for July. Data from the Federal Reserve indicated that U.S. industrial production rose by 0.2%, which was half of the 0.4% increase that analysts polled by The Wall Street Journal had anticipated. items.title: Is General Electric (GE) Priced For Perfection After Its Massive Run?
items.summary: General Electric stock has delivered a very strong run over the past five years, yet current checks suggest the share price now trades at a premium to what a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiples imply. General Electric has returned roughly 5x over the past five years, which puts extra focus on whether recent gains leave limited room for valuation upside. items.title: GE Aerospace Rises 19.9% YTD: Is the Rally Still Worth Chasing?
items.summary: GE's 19.9% YTD rally reflects strong commercial and defense demand, but rising costs, debt and a premium valuation temper near-term upside.

items.title: Hold GE Aerospace Even as Wall Street Remains Bullish
items.summary: GE Aerospace keeps beating estimates, raising guidance, and sitting on a $210 billion backlog, yet the stock may already be priced to perfection with margin pressures quietly building beneath the surface.
